title: Cokernel cuts and the concrete signed extension class
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with derived Ext [def-pc-ext]. For a positive-degree extension [def-coef-yoneda-extension-data], its head is the short exact sequence formed by its first injection and its cokernel projection. For degree at least two, its tail replaces the first two objects by that cokernel and uses the descended next differential. This is an extension of degree one less. Its concrete derived class in degree one is minus its short exact connecting class, conjugated by the endpoint isomorphisms. In degree $n+2$ the class is $(-1)^n$ times the composite of the tail class, the head connecting class, and the first endpoint identification. These are real constructions using successive cokernels. Maps of extensions induce maps of the heads and tails.
